fit_contract.cohort_fit: CAL_A11 pooled, source-equal weight 1/(S*n_c); DEV11 NEVER enters any fit
fit_contract.density_anti_leakage: 11x256 and 11x512 are SEPARATE fits; no shared alpha/P/Q/normalization/ridge between prefixes
fit_contract.A0_prior: USER ADJUDICATED 2026-11-14: fresh per-config Q0. A0=A(alpha_Q0), alpha_Q0_j=E[dZ_j dH_j]/E[dZ_j^2] on the CAL training subset (dZ=X@W1^T, dH=tanhGELU(z1)-tanhGELU(z0)). Common base shared by all representations within a config; no old-CAL4 Dq reuse.
fit_contract.current_q1: R2 Problem PCG (q1_fit_core verbatim), alpha init=alpha_Q0, ridge lambda=1e-3 toward A0 (matrix distance), maxiter=240 tol=1e-5 restart@20. Fresh fit -> NO R2 old/new per-layer selection.
fit_contract.stable_free_linear: free DxD correction D on Q1 residual R=Y-X@A_Q1, ridge toward 0 rho=lambda/||A_Q1||^2, lambda=1e-3. Reuses R1b stable_ridge_fit VERBATIM (F64 weighted thin-SVD DIRECT solve + F64 eigh cross-check). Bank gate c_gate_msa is timestep modulation, per-channel and SHARED across sources at a site (verified maxdiff=0.0; common_gate() asserts). A_free=A_Q1+D; certificates cross_check_f64_eigh_rel_l2<=1e-7, D_out_of_rowspace_rel_fro<=1e-10.
fit_contract.representation: B(u)=uA0+(uP)C_L Q^T+tanh(uP)C_N Q^T. P/Q FIXED by CAL data SVD: P=top-64 right singular vectors of weighted stacked X; Q=top-32 of weighted stacked gated residual (Y-XA0)odot g. Readout C fitted convexly (gated least squares, sum-of-Kronecker normal system, F64, relative Tikhonov floor 1e-6). bias b=0, no center offset.

representation_variants.L64_Q32: Phi=X@P64 (linear only, k=64, readout 64x32=2048 = capacity control matching N methods C_L+C_N=2048)
representation_variants.ENDPOINT_N32: Phi=[u_t@P32-u_s@P32, tanh(u_t@P32)-tanh(u_s@P32)] (k=64; state info through per-endpoint tanh)

fit_contract.odd_symmetry: zero displacement -> zero prediction; endpoint swap -> sign flip (verified by construction, no center offset)

estimand.primary: M(c,e,m)=equal-mean over layers {4,19,34} of gatedSSE/(rows*5120); r=(M_m-M_CURRENT_Q1)/M_CURRENT_Q1; expert-equal within source then source-equal
estimand.scoring: F64 gated pre-gate INCREMENT math lift: SSE=sum(((pred-Y)odot g)^2), Y=y_hit-y_anchor, g=hit-step per-channel gate. BF16 cache/gate replay is a SEPARATE V4D check, NOT the V4 primary.
estimand.floor: CAL neutral numerical-error floor = mean BF16 cache/gate replay rounding MSE of Q1 on CAL; per-source relative quantities flagged when Q1 denominator M(c,e,Q1) < floor
estimand.aggregation_policy: fixed before viewing results; no post-hoc main-summary switch
